title: Bromo Marathon 2026 Review: What the 13th Edition Was Like
seo_title: Bromo Marathon 2026 Review | Tosari, East Java
meta_description: Bromo Marathon 2026 review: about 3,000 runners from 22 countries on the slopes of Mount Bromo on 6 September, on a new route after forest fires.
dek: The mountain marathon on the slopes of Mount Bromo held its 13th edition on 6 September 2026, on a new route after forest fires hit the usual one. Here is what it was like, from the reporting on it.
verdict: The Bromo Marathon is not a road race. The 13th edition, on Sunday 6 September 2026, took about 3,000 runners from 22 countries over dirt tracks, villagers' farmland and forest on the slopes of Mount Bromo, from a start and finish at Plataran Bromo in Tosari [1][2]. The 2026 route was new, because forest fires had hit the usual one, and the race director said it put more emphasis on the natural landscape and posed a new challenge, especially over 42 km [1][2]. If you want a scenic, off-road marathon at altitude with an international field, 13 editions have made this a well-established choice. Don't expect a road-marathon time.

sections.heading: The 2026 Edition
paragraphs: About 3,000 runners from 22 countries took part in the 13th Bromo Marathon on Sunday 6 September 2026 [1][2]. The start and finish were in the grounds of Plataran Bromo in Tosari, Pasuruan regency [1][2], and the theme was I Run The Adventure [1].

There were five categories: the full marathon, a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and a 2.5 km kids' race [1][2]. One report lists the half-marathon category as 22 km [1] and another as 21 km [2], so check the distance for your year before you plan a pace.

sections.heading: A New Route After the Fires
paragraphs: The usual main route had been affected by forest fires, so the 2026 course was changed [1][2]. It crossed dirt tracks, villagers' farmland and forest on the slopes of Bromo [1][2].

Race director Dedik Kurniawan said the new route put more emphasis on the natural landscape and was a new challenge, particularly for the 42 km runners, and that enthusiasm was higher despite the change [1]. Whether the 2027 race keeps this route or returns to the old one is worth checking when entries open.

sections.heading: Should You Enter Next Year?
paragraphs: If you want a marathon that is an adventure more than a time trial, yes. Thirteen editions in, it draws an international field, and the Tengger highlands around Bromo are the whole point of going.

Prepare for it as a trail race. Dirt, farm tracks and forest at altitude call for different shoes, pacing and cut-off planning than a city marathon, and the 42 km on the 2026 route was described by the organiser himself as a challenge.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2026 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran the Bromo Marathon in 2026?
faqs.answer: About 3,000 runners from 22 countries took part in the 13th edition on Sunday 6 September 2026, starting and finishing at Plataran Bromo in Tosari, Pasuruan, East Java. Categories ranged from a 2.5 km kids' race to the full marathon.

faqs.question: Is the Bromo Marathon on roads or trails?
faqs.answer: Mostly off-road. The 2026 route crossed dirt tracks, villagers' farmland and forest on the slopes of Mount Bromo. It was a new route that year, because forest fires had affected the usual one, and the organiser called the 42 km a new challenge.

faqs.question: What distances does the Bromo Marathon offer?
faqs.answer: Five in 2026: the full marathon, a half marathon (reported as 21 km by one source and 22 km by another), 10 km, 5 km and a 2.5 km kids' race. Check the official distances for your year before you enter.

editorial_notes: Rewritten 2026-09-28 about the 2026 edition, which was run on 6 September. Replaces a pre-race preview. The two reports disagree on the half-marathon distance (21 km or 22 km); both are given. No rating: nothing here is participant evidence.
